discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
motivation: Topological insulators revealed that band insulators come in distinct topological classes protected by time-reversal symmetry, with robust metallic edge and surface states. Kane (with Mele) established the Z2 topological invariant and the quantum spin Hall state, and with Fu predicted three-dimensional topological insulators and their surface Dirac fermions. Molenkamp's group, growing precise HgTe/CdTe quantum wells, gave the first experimental demonstration of the quantum spin Hall effect in 2007, a decisive transport realisation of a theoretical prediction. Hasan's group used spin-resolved photoemission to discover the first three-dimensional topological insulators, Bi1-xSbx and Bi2Se3, directly imaging spin-helical surface states. This work created a new field linking topology, symmetry and materials, and led to the quantum anomalous Hall effect, topological superconductivity proposals and the broader classification of topological phases now central to condensed matter physics and future low-dissipation and quantum information technologies.
